Bug_Title: ASE: Method invoked in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The method 'getCounter()' is invoked in an assertion statement which leads to a side effect. This side effect changes the state of the 'counter' variable and may affect the assertion result. When assertions are disabled, this side effect will not occur.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the `showBug` method which contains an assertion involving the `getCounter` method. The assertion is evaluated during the execution of the test case and may change the state of the `counter` variable, causing a side effect. This side effect may affect the assertion result.
